## Final prompt

+Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art NPC sprite sheet for PETOA, a classic top-down 16-bit Japanese RPG.
Draw ADBA (アドバ), an adult Middle Eastern merchant, around forty years old, as ONE consistent charming but grounded pixel-art game character in FOUR idle directions. Warm medium olive skin, dark brown eyes, short well-kept dark beard and moustache, friendly composed expression. Modest cream wrapped cloth head covering, muted terracotta long tunic, dark teal sleeveless outer vest with restrained ochre trim, brown sash, loose sand-colored trousers and brown leather shoes. A practical leather cross-body merchant satchel on his LEFT hip, strap from RIGHT shoulder. Maintain that same physical placement across all views. Hands empty and resting naturally at sides, no weapons. Quietly distinctive silhouette, dignified approachable trader, no exaggerated facial features or luxurious caricature.
EXACTLY four full-body sprites in one single evenly spaced horizontal row, occupying four equal-width cells: 1 FRONT facing down toward viewer, 2 RIGHT PROFILE facing screen right, 3 LEFT PROFILE facing screen left, 4 BACK facing away/up. Each figure centered in its own cell with identical foot baseline and identical head height. All figures fully visible, generous transparent padding, no overlap. Same outfit, proportions, colors and satchel in every view. NOT walking animation, all neutral standing pose.
Canvas 1536x512 landscape sprite sheet with four equal 384x512 cells. Native-art feel of roughly 32x48 logical pixels per figure, enlarged with crisp square pixel blocks. Match compact existing PETOA NPC proportions: slightly oversized head, short sturdy body about 3 heads tall, small hands and boots, three-quarter top-down RPG view, selective dark outlines, limited warm pixel palette and compact two-to-three-tone shading, upper-left light. Not a detailed illustration, not smooth anime, not photorealistic, no blur or antialiasing.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT background with alpha around and between all sprites. No ground, no drop-shadow oval, no checkerboard drawn into image, no scenery, no border, no typography, no direction labels, no names, no watermark. Four views of the SAME man.
